name: Neo4j
description: Graph database management system and data platform for connected data, offering native graph storage, Cypher query language, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

evidence.claim: Neo4j provides official drivers and libraries for accessing the graph database
Basic and token-based authentication are supported via Authorization header
Neo4j offers an official MCP server for bridging LLM clients and Neo4j graph databases

notes: Neo4j provides official drivers in multiple languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, .NET), a Query API supporting basic/bearer tokens, and official MCP support for connecting LLM clients directly to Neo4j and Aura instances.
